_A_UTILITIES_BORDER_STYLE_DESCRIPTION_: a_border_style_dashed and a_border_style_dotted change the line of a_border, a_border_top, a_border_right, a_border_bottom, a_border_left, a_tile. a_border_{color}_subtle sets a light border color that fits the a_bg_{color}_subtle backgrounds. Colors: primary, secondary, tertiary, success, info, warning, danger, light, dark.
_A_UTILITIES_CURSOR_DESCRIPTION_: Classes set the mouse cursor: a_cursor_pointer, a_cursor_default, a_cursor_not_allowed, a_cursor_move, a_cursor_text, a_cursor_help, a_cursor_grab, a_cursor_grabbing, a_cursor_wait, a_cursor_crosshair. Hover over the elements.
_A_UTILITIES_DIVIDER_VERTICAL_DESCRIPTIO: a_divider_vertical draws a vertical line between the items of a row, e.g. in a_hstack. It takes the height of the row and the color of a_divider (--a_divider_bg). A decorative line gets aria-hidden="true"; a line that separates groups of controls gets role="separator" + aria-orientation="vertical".
_A_UTILITIES_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION_: The two-colored focus ring of the components for own focusable elements, e.g. a card with tabindex="0". It is shown for keyboard focus only and is configured with the focus tokens.
_A_UTILITIES_HOVER_DESCRIPTION_: Colors on hover and keyboard focus. a_link_muted is a link in the muted text color that gets the link color on hover. a_bg_{color}_hover sets the hover tone of a color, e.g. together with a_bg_primary. a_bg_{color}_subtle_hover sets the subtle background, e.g. for list items and cards. Colors: primary, secondary, tertiary, success, info, warning, danger, light, dark.
_A_UTILITIES_OBJECT_FIT_DESCRIPTION_: Classes set how an image or a video fills its box (object-fit): a_object_fit_cover fills the box and crops the image, a_object_fit_contain shows the whole image, a_object_fit_fill stretches it, a_object_fit_none keeps the original size, a_object_fit_scale_down uses none or contain, whichever is smaller.
_A_UTILITIES_ORDER_DESCRIPTION_: Classes set the order of flex and grid items: a_order_first (−1), a_order_0 … a_order_5, a_order_last (6). Suffixes _mobile … _large enable them at breakpoints.
_A_UTILITIES_POINTER_EVENTS_DESCRIPTION_: a_pointer_events_none makes an element ignore the mouse and touch, a_pointer_events_auto turns them on again for a child element. The keyboard still works, so also set tabindex="-1" and aria-disabled for a disabled link.
_A_UTILITIES_PRINT_DESCRIPTION_: a_print_none hides an element when printing, a_print_block shows it only in print (together with a_d_none).
_A_UTILITIES_RADIUS_DESCRIPTION_: Classes set the corner radius from the --a_border_radius_* tokens: a_radius_small, a_radius, a_radius_large, a_radius_xl, a_radius_2xl. a_pill_rounded makes the corners fully round, a_rounded_circle makes a square element a circle, a_rounded_0 removes the radius.
_A_UTILITIES_RATIO_DESCRIPTION_: Classes set the aspect-ratio of an element: a_ratio_1x1, a_ratio_4x3, a_ratio_16x9, a_ratio_21x9. The height follows the width, e.g. for videos, maps and image placeholders.
_A_UTILITIES_ROUNDED_CIRCLE_DESCRIPTION_: a_rounded_circle makes a square element round, e.g. an avatar or a status dot.
_A_UTILITIES_SHADOW_DESCRIPTION_: Classes set the shadow from the --a_shadow_* tokens: a_shadow_sm, a_shadow_md, a_shadow_lg. a_shadow_none removes a shadow. The shadows are adapted for the dark theme.
_A_UTILITIES_SIZING_DESCRIPTION_: Classes set the width and the height: a_width_* / a_height_* (1 … 6, 25 … 100 %, 1rem … 3rem, auto; a_width_50px … a_width_400px), a_max_width_* (300px … 800px, 25 … 100 %, none), a_max_height_100, a_max_height_none, a_min_width_0, a_min_width_100, a_min_height_0, a_min_height_100. a_min_width_0 lets a flex item shrink below the width of its content, e.g. for a_text_truncate. a_viewport_height_100 and a_min_viewport_height_100 use 100vh, the variants _100dvh use the visible height on mobile devices with browser bars. Suffixes _mobile … _large enable them at breakpoints.
_A_UTILITIES_STACK_DESCRIPTION_: a_vstack places the items one below the other (flex column), a_hstack next to each other and centers them vertically (flex row). The space between the items is set with a_gap_*, a_ml_auto pushes an item to the end.
_A_UTILITIES_STRETCHED_LINK_DESCRIPTION_: a_stretched_link makes the whole parent with a_position_relative clickable, e.g. a card. There is still only one link with a clear text for keyboard and screen reader users. Other links and buttons in the card need a_position_relative and a_z_index_2 to stay clickable.
_A_UTILITIES_TEXT_DESCRIPTION_: Secondary and emphasized text that stays readable in the light and the dark theme.
_A_UTILITIES_TEXT_SELECT_DESCRIPTION_: With a_text_select_all one click selects the whole text, e.g. an ID or a token to copy. a_text_select_none prevents selecting the text.
_A_UTILITIES_VISIBILITY_DESCRIPTION_: a_invisible hides an element, but it keeps its place in the layout, unlike a_d_none. a_visible shows it again. A hidden element is also hidden for screen readers.
_A_UTILITIES_Z_INDEX_DESCRIPTION_: Global layers use the --a_z_index_* tokens, so own overlays stay in the right order with modals, dropdowns and popups.
